aria: quick heads-up — canary with the new continuous-batcher (token-budget gating + kernel hint) shows a p95 regression on route `chat-interactive`. attaching quick perf dump.

perfbot: canary metrics snapshot: p50 22ms (baseline 20ms), p95 128ms (baseline 83ms), kv_hit_rate 61% (was 87%), avg_batch_size 5.2 (expected ~6.8), kernel_switches +42%.

jyoti: do we have kernel-selection traces? looks like the runtime is falling back to a slower kernel path a lot for long sequences. sample from node-17 logs: 
```
# kernel select: route=chat-interactive seq_len=800 kv_hit=false last_kernel=fast_attn_v2 -> fallback=quant_fp16_safe (latency+36ms)
# batch_size=4 token_budget_left=120 prefetch_kv=false
```

matt: rolling the canary back now (started rollback). @lena will try tuned batcher params after rollback.

deploy-bot: rollback initiated for canary cb-2026-01 (target group: batcher-canary). status: in_progress.

samir: quick hypothesis: the token-budget gating reduced avg_batch_size which lowered KV reuse windows, hurting kv hit rate and forcing kernel fallbacks. propose conservative token budgets per tier and enable kv prefetch for this route. sample suggestion: 
```
# batcher heuristics tweak (proposal)
token_budget_targets:
  route: chat-interactive
  tiers:
    gold: "1024"
    standard: "768"
    free: "512"
queue_policy:
  max_wait_ms: "18"
  prefetch_kv: "true"
  prefer_kernel: "fast_attn_v2"
```

aria: sounds reasonable. can we run the microbench harness before re-roll? `./tools/batch_sim --route chat-interactive --variant=with-prefetch --duration=300s`

jyoti: also disable `early_kernel_prefetch` for the next canary — that feature is increasing kernel churn for mixed-length batches. small change: `early_kernel_prefetch=false` in runtime flags.

lena: started a new canary with adjusted budgets and kv prefetch (cb-2026-02). pinging this thread for metric update :eyes:

perfbot: cb-2026-02 initial pass: p50 21ms, p95 90ms, kv_hit_rate 79%, avg_batch_size 6.4, kernel_switches +8% (much improved).

aria: good initial signal. keep monitoring for 30m. if p95 stays <100ms and kv_hit_rate >75% we can promote and then iterate on lowering standard tier budgets more aggressively.

matt: note for release notes: add a short blurb about batcher token targets per route and the KV-prefetch opt-in.

aria: action items: 1) jyoti to flip `early_kernel_prefetch=false` in canary config (done), 2) samir to run `batch_sim` and share trace (in progress), 3) lena to watch cb-2026-02 for 30m then promote if stable. I'll file a short postmortem if the first canary regressed.

lena: will update here in ~25m with final numbers. :thumbsup:
